answer.justification: Only output-level measurements are available. The exact-match rate is 0.031 and the median first divergence is 9.5, which fits quantized (10-17) better than system-prompted (0) and is slightly later than fine-tuned (5.5-8). The edit distance of 0.505 is just below the quantized range (0.52-0.57). It is well under the fine-tuned (0.56-0.65) and system-prompted (0.79-0.82) ranges, so those fit worse. Stage directions are 3.1%, close to the reference's 1.6%, and there is no shift in voice. Refusals dropped is 3 of 64, which is above the quantized range (0-1). That value is possible for fine-tuned (0-5), so fine-tuned remains a real alternative. Base is ruled out because the exact-match rate is not 1 and the divergence is early. Edit distance and divergence position favor quantized over fine-tuned.
